source_evidence: Before you engage an investment professional or purchase securities, make sure you research and verify all information.
answer: “Ask and Check” means researching and verifying information before you hire an investment professional or buy securities. Use appropriate public tools to examine relevant background details and disclosures. For example, IAPD provides information about investment advisers, BrokerCheck provides information about brokers and brokerage firms, and EDGAR provides company filings and financial statements. Checking these sources can help you ask informed questions before making a decision.
